items.t: UNIST-한수원, '에너지×AI 융합 연구혁신센터' 가동
items.d: UNIST(총장 박종래)와 한국수력원자력(이하 한수원)은 3일 UNIST에서 '에너지×인공지능(AI) 융합 연구혁신센터' 현판식을 열고 공동 연구에 본격 나섰다. 공동 연구 분야는 △AI 기반 원전 운영 최적화 및 안전성 향상 △발전소 자동화 및 에너지·수소 통합운영 △AI 융합기술의 응용 분야 확장 등이다. 공동 연구에는 원자력공학과, 인공지능대학원, 탄소중립대학원, U미래전략원 등 UNIST 주요 연구 조직이 참여한다. KAIST, 미래와도
items.fullText: 전국 UNIST-한수원, '에너지×AI 융합 연구혁신센터' 가동 발행일 : 2026-11-03 14:08 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 원전 운영·안전부터 자동화까지 AI 접목 연구 현장 수요 기반 7개 핵심과제 추진 UNIST(총장 박종래)와 한국수력원자력(이하 한수원)은 3일 UNIST에서 '에너지×인공지능(AI) 융합 연구혁신센터' 현판식을 열고 공동 연구에 본격 나섰다. 공동 연구 분야는 △AI 기반 원전 운영 최적화 및 안전성 향상 △발전소 자동화 및 에너지·수소 통합운영 △AI 융합기술의 응용 분야 확장 등이다. 공동 연구에는 원자력공학과, 인공지능대학원, 탄소중립대학원, U미래전략원 등 UNIST 주요 연구 조직이 참여한다. KAIST, 미래와도전 등도 공동 연구기관으로 함께 한다. 현판식에 앞서 '에너지×AI 융합 연구혁신센터'는 한수원 현장 수요와 AI 융합기술의 활용 가능성을 바탕으로 6개 핵심 연구과제와 단기 기술실증을 위한 퀵윈(Quick-Win, 즉각적 성과) 과제를 선정해 추진해왔다. 양 기관은 이번 현판식을 계기로 공동연구 성과의 현장 적용을 추진하고 기술 수요에 맞춰 새로운 과제를 도출할 계획이다. 박종래 총장은 “한수원과 협력은 대학 연구성과를 실제 에너지 산업 현장에 접목하는 중요한 산학협력 모델”이라며 “AI와 원자력·에너지 분야 융합으로 국가 에너지산업의 안전성과 경쟁력을 높이는 실질적 연구성과를 도출하겠다”고 말했다. 이광훈 한수원 품질기술본부장은 “에너지 산업 AI 전환은 현장에 대한 이해와 첨단 연구역량의 결합이 중요하다. UNIST와 공동연구로 현장 적용 혁신기술을 지속적으로 발굴하겠다”고 전했다. 울산=임동식 기자 dslim@etnews.com

items.t: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
items.d: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.
items.fullText: Squarespace, the web company that helps customers build and host their own websites, is laying off about one-fifth of its workforce, in a move that will affect hundreds of jobs. Jeff Seedman, a public relations specialist representing Squarespace, confirmed the layoffs to TechCrunch. The Verge initially reported the layoffs. “Squarespace is restructuring its organization and reducing its global workforce by approximately 19%, representing around 300 employees,” said Seedman. “The changes are intended to simplify how we operate, sharpen our priorities and enable the company to move faster as we position Squarespace for its next phase of growth.” Website building has changed immensely over the last few years as a result of the generative AI boom. “Vibe-coding” website builders, which only require simple prompts from users to spin up functional front-end designs, have largely upended the industry, making it possible for users to create sites with significantly less effort. These kinds of sites have become an increasingly central part of the website-building business. Last year, web host rival Wix bought Base44 for $80 million . Similar offerings, like Lovable, have generated significant investor interest; Lovable raised a $400 million Series C round in August that valued the company at $13.3 billion. Google also recently launched Stitch , a feature that allows users to swiftly generate user-interface designs. Squarespace has also begun a big push into AI. In 2024, the company launched an AI tool called Blueprint. The company also recently announced Forma, an upcoming AI native platform, whose waitlist users can join . Squarespace was founded in 2004 and went public in 2021 at a $10 billion valuation. However, the company struggled in the ensuing years to generate enthusiastic public market interest. Squarespace ultimately decided to go private again by way of a $7 billion private equity deal in 2024. An earlier version of this report

items.t: SpaceX reportedly wants to buy Boost Mobile to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
items.d: SpaceX has been looking for new ways to use its Starlink network, and a tie-up with cellular operator Boost Mobile could give it the terrestrial access it needs.
items.fullText: SpaceX is looking to buy Boost Mobile from EchoStar, according to a report from The Washington Post. If the deal goes through, it would help the Elon Musk-owned company build a hybrid cellular-satellite network that could help catapult it into fourth place among the top U.S. wireless providers. The space-launch company has been dabbling in cellular connectivity, rolling out satellite access to T-Mobile’s subscribers in 2024. Last year, SpaceX bought $17 billion worth of wireless spectrum from EchoStar for cellular services, which could help the company’s Starlink service reach inside buildings, for example, something it currently struggles with. “This is the last critical piece of the spectrum puzzle needed for SpaceX to provide complete phone coverage in America,” Musk said on X at the time of the spectrum acquisition. Yet, if Musk is still looking to buy access to terrestrial networks, it apparently wasn’t the last piece. Elon Musk, SpaceX’s CEO, reportedly spoke directly with EchoStar chairman Charlie Ergen in October about acquiring Boost Mobile, the mobile virtual network operator. EchoStar has about 7.5 million customers between Boost Mobile and Gen Mobile, its other mobile service offering. Musk has also approached AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon about buying capacity on their networks. All three rejected Musk, and they may still have a say in a SpaceX acquisition of Boost Mobile. Boost doesn’t operate its own towers, instead leasing capacity from AT&T and T-Mobile, which might need to approve such a deal. Sources speaking to The Post said that network leases are usually nontransferable. The big three providers each have over 100 million subscribers, dwarfing Boost Mobile. But while the acquisition would give SpaceX an immediate bump in subscribers, the true value of the deal would be giving the company access to terrestrial cellular networks.
